stories.story: Lily wanted to eat the bread, but a rabbit shivered on a high ledge. Lily said, “The rabbit needs help.” Dad said, “I can lower the basket.” Lily said, “I can share the bread.” Lily put the bread in the basket. Dad carried the basket to the window, and he lowered the basket to the ledge with the rope. Lily waited because the rabbit was frightened. The rabbit entered the basket, and it ate the bread. Dad lowered the basket to the garden with the rope. Lily carried the rabbit into the cottage, and she wrapped the rabbit in the warm blanket. Lily was hungry, but the rabbit rested in the warm blanket.
